scope: PGL2(11) is sharply 3-transitive, common Clifford reduces balanced triples to rank1, independent isotropic and symplectic (opposite sign merged by swapping ordered sites), plus balanced pair. Four Hermitian compressions. Greedily choose ceil(n/5) orthogonal vectors with all cross compressions zero; Tverberg yields floor((s-1)/5)+1 scalar-compression vectors. Exact existence, not explicit basis or optimality.
